books.blurb: When a team of AI agents works while you're away.
gist: One lead, many helpers. A lead AI splits a big job into pieces, helper AIs work on the pieces at the same time, and a checker puts the results together.

You still own the result. More helpers mean more computing power and more checking. Whatever they produce, you are still responsible for it.

gist: Inflation means the same money buys less: US prices roughly doubled from 2000 to 2026.
The 2021-22 spike had several causes stacked together: money and demand, supply chains, energy and some company pricing.
Inflation quietly moves buying power between shoppers, savers, workers, borrowers and governments.
